title: Module test B2.1 · News and institutions

blocks.text: Module test B2.1 · News and institutions
Instructions

Week 181 of the calendar, after verification of B2-01 → B2-06 and INT-03 (and, for the Egyptian, EGY-11 and EGY-12; EGY-13 is still in progress and enters the test only with task F3). Duration: approx. 120 minutes for parts A/E, plus 15 minutes of interview with the tutor. Work without notes; the dictionary by root is allowed only in part D (translation). Fix it with the solution. Part B scripts are at the beginning of solutions: make them read to another person (the song 3 to an Egyptian speaker) or use vocal synthesis for songs in fuṣḥā, without reading them. The text of Part A is without vowels.

E · Written production (8 points)

Write in Arabic a news (200–230 words) for a newspaper invented on this invented story: the municipality of a large Arab city has approved a plan to transform an old port into a pedestrian area with museums and shops; an association of fishermen has appealed to the Administrative Court; The mayor speaks of a historic opportunity. an economist provides benefits for tourism but warns of costs; The first hearing is scheduled for next month. Required elements: title and subtitle (B2-01) · attack with whom, what, when, source · at least one chain of iḍāfa of three terms and one relative without ⁧الَّذِي⁩ ( B2-02) · at least one numerical data with the correct preposition (B2-04) · the correct judicial lexicon (B2-05) · three voices attributed with three different verbs · a prediction with the degree of certainty · no adjective evaluative of the author. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Organization and neutrality 1–4. Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1); an unassigned judgment removes 1 I'm on the point of Neutrality.
